# Step 1: login to Spotify using credentials from supervisor
import re

creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
spotify_email = 'carbrown@gmail.com'

print('spotify_email', spotify_email)
print('spotify_pw', spotify_pw)

res = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_email, password=spotify_pw)
print(res)
access_token = res['access_token']

# Fetch Spotify song queue and identify songs played so far (assume positions <= current position)
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('queue_type', type(queue))
print('queue', queue)
current_pos = None
for s in queue:
    if s.get('is_current') or s.get('is_playing'):
        current_pos = s.get('position')
        break
print('current_pos', current_pos)
played = [s for s in queue if s.get('position') is not None and current_pos is not None and s['position'] <= current_pos]
print('played_ids', [s['song_id'] for s in played])
print('played_songs', [(s['position'], s['title'], [a['name'] for a in s.get('artists',[])]) for s in played])
